The Mandatory BIM in Construction

Includes the attobution of the BIM Excellence Awards 2021

28 July | 16h00 | Live no YouTube BUILT CoLAB

BUILT COLAB invites you to watch TechOnBUILT | WebTalk’Series, a series of online conversations under the Digital and Climate Transition in the AEC sector, which will address the theme “The Obligation of BIM in Construction”.

Guest Speakers

Eduardo Toledo Santos |  Universidade de São Paulo Ricardo Codinhoto |  Universidade de Bath

Moderation

António Aguiar Costa | RD&I Director BUILT CoLAB

BIM Excellence Awards 2021

  • PRESENTATION OF THE BIM Award
  • Announcement of honorable mentions
  • Announcement of the winners of each category

Participation is free, but registration is mandatory and must be done here.

About TechOnBUILT | WebTalk’Series

TechOnBUILT | WebTalk’Series is an initiative of BUILT CoLAB that promotes a set of extensive online conversations on the Digital and Climate Transition in the AEC sector, and which aim to contribute to the discussion of topics of practical interest to companies in this sector. Each WebTalk has two to three guests who will address and talk about the topic dedicated to broadcasting, in a virtual “roundtable” format moderated by a BUILT CoLAB team member. It is broadcasted live on our Youtube channel and the recording will be later made available on our website and various digital channels.
